name: Pip the Cannoneer
bio: Sits behind the chunky bronze cannon on a grassy hill in Kaboom Keep, aiming at toy-block castles.

portrait.subject: a cute chibi cannoneer kid with a big round helmet, a toy-soldier jacket with brass buttons, sooty cheeks and a little match, next to a chunky bronze cannon
portrait.background: grassy meadow hill with a toy-block castle in the distance

request: Pip the Cannoneer, Kaboom Keep! Wanna knock down castles together? Friends! 💣
hello: Hit the bottom blocks and the whole tower tips!
about: I'm Pip! I sit behind my bronze cannon and aim at toy-block castles. Knock over every little person in them!
how: Aim the cannon, choose your ball, and blast toy-block castles. Knock down every little person to earn stars across 48 castles.
tips: Boom Balls go off early. Use them on towers.
Triple Trouble splits. Great for wide castles.
chat: Blew up a castle so hard the flag landed on my head.
The kings always look surprised. Every time.
Moonbeam Marsh explosions glow! So pretty!
nudge: A new castle's standing. Not for long!
update: KABOOM! Kaboom Keep is now v{version}!
